Erra and Išum – Standard Babylonian I: “King Of All Settlements, Creator Of The Universe, […]!”

Meanings are from the eBL dictionary (largely based on CDA – Black, George & Postgate, A Concise Dictionary of Akkadian). Stem-specific meanings (G, D, Š, N…) follow the main gloss.

abnu I

  • Meaning: m. & f.; pl. abnū and abnātu(m) "stone" [NA4]
  • Logograms: NA4
  • Lines: 161
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/abnu%20I

abu I

  • Meaning: "father" (st. constr. abi, occas. abu, ab; nom. with pron. suff. abī, M/NB, NA also abū(y)a; abūšu etc.; pl. abbū, O/MA abbā'ū, MB(Alal.), Am. abbūtu) [AD]
  • Logograms: AD
  • Lines: 75
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/abu%20I

abātu I

  • Meaning: "to destroy"
    • G: (a/u, O/jB also i'abbat, i'but (cf. GAG §97h)) objects, buildings; living beings; OA "ruin (economically)"
    • D: "destroy completely" objects, parts of body, living beings; jB occas. + eli instead of acc.
    • Dt: pass. of D [GUL.MEŠ]
    • Š: caus. of G OB(lit.)
    • N: pass. of G (forms cf. GAG §97j)
  • Logograms: GUL.MEŠ
  • Lines: 35, 69
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ab%C4%81tu%20I

abūbu I

  • Meaning: "flood, deluge" Bab. [A.MA.RU]
  • Logograms: A.MA.RU
  • Lines: 132, 140, 145
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ab%C5%ABbu%20I

Adad I

  • Meaning: —
  • Lines: 115
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/Adad%20I

adi I

  • Meaning: "until, as far as" [EN]
  • Logograms: EN, A.RÁ
  • Lines: 19, 79, 135, 138, 178, 181, 182
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/adi%20I

agû I

  • Meaning: "tiara, crown" [AGA] symbol of rule of god, king; transf. jB "corona" of planet, star, sun; OB om. "circle" of oil, incense; jB lex. "ring, band" round axe;
  • Logograms: AGA
  • Lines: 128, 143, 161
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ag%C3%BB%20I

agāgu I

  • Meaning: "to be(come) furious" Bab.
    • G: (a/u; stat. agug) of god, human
    • Gtn: "be steadfastly angry"?
    • D: stat. only "is very angry"
    • Š: caus. of G
    • N: "get angry"
  • Lines: 123, 132
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ag%C4%81gu%20I

ahulap I

  • Meaning: (or ahulab), OB also ahulup, OB lex. ahulapum "(it is) enough!" OAkk, Bab.; as declaration of clemency by god, as petition for clemency by worshipper; jB šam a. (a plant name);
  • Lines: 101
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ahulap%20I

ahû I

  • Meaning: "outside(r), strange" [BAR] of person, also as subst. "stranger"; (desig. of planet =) Mars; of appearance "abnormal"; of textual passage "noncanonical, extraneous" [pl. also BAR.BAR];
  • Logograms: BAR
  • Lines: 24
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ah%C3%BB%20I

ai I

  • Meaning: (before consonant), â, ya "not"
  • Lines: 32
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ai%20I

akû I

  • Meaning: "weak, powerless, humble" M/NB, jB;
  • Lines: 54, 56
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ak%C3%BB%20I

akālu I

  • Meaning: "to eat"
    • G: (a/u) [GU7]
    • Gtn: iter. of G [GU7.GU7]
    • Gt: of lands "ravage each other"; of stars "cover, absorb each other"
    • Š: caus. of G [GU7] "make" men, animals, fire "eat, feed on, consume" food, medication, goods, booty, lands; "steep" an object in liquid; OA "satisfy" a claimant; jB stat. "is infected" with a disease
    • Št: [GU7] OB math. "multiply together", freq. "square" measured lengths N pass. of G [GU7]
  • Logograms: GU7, GU7.GU7
  • Lines: 49
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ak%C4%81lu%20I

ali I

  • Meaning: "where?" OAkk, Ass., O/jB
  • Lines: 150, 154, 155, 158, 159, 161, 162
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ali%20I

alpu I

  • Meaning: "bull, ox" [GU4; coll. pl. GU4.HI.A; NA usu. GU4.(NÍTA.)MEŠ]; a. mê, a. nāri "water, river ox"; a. kīši "water buffalo"? jB; a. šadê (a wild animal) Am.; a. epinnim "plough ox"; a. warkatim [GU4.(Á.)ÙR.RA] "rear ox (of team)"; math. pūt alpim 'ox's forehead', i.e. "trapezoid" [SAG.KI.GU4]
  • Logograms: GU4, GU4.HI.A, GU4.MEŠ GU4.NÍTA.MEŠ
  • Lines: 189
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/alpu%20I

alādu I

  • Meaning: "to give birth (to)" [Ù.TU; occas. TU]
    • G: (a/i)
    • Gtn: iter. of G [Ù.TU.MEŠ]
    • Dt: pass. of D "be begotten"
    • Š: caus. of G
    • N: pass. of G children mala waldū u iwwalladū "as many as are or shall be born"
  • Logograms: Ù.TU, TU, Ù.TU.MEŠ
  • Lines: 29
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/al%C4%81du%20I

alāku I

  • Meaning: "to go"
    • G: (illak, illik; perf. ittalak (cf. GAG §97n)) [DU]
    • Gtn: [DU.DU] "go, come repeatedly; roam about, wander", muttallik mūši [LÚ.GE6.A.DU.DU; (LÚ.)GE6.DU.DU] 'who walks around during the night' = "night-watchman"; OB of leg muscles "twitch persistently"
    • Gt: "go off, away" (cf. GAG §92e) differentiation between pret. of Gt and perf. of G difficult
    • Š: caus. of G [DU] with abstr. noun ending in -ūtu or adv. "make s.o./s.th. (become)" s.th.; stat. "is appropriate, suitable" [TÚM.MA]
  • Logograms: DU, IGI.DU, DU.DU
  • Lines: 32, 40, 44, 51, 98, 99, 114, 151
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/al%C4%81ku%20I

amāru I

  • Meaning: "to see"
    • G: (a/u) [IGI; IGI.DU8]
    • R: Mari
    • Gtn: iter. of G; Mari stat. "has learnt thoroughly"
    • Gt: jB "see from now on"?, mng. uncl.
    • D: rare; OA "examine" metal; cf. mummertu
    • Š: caus. of G
    • Št: "make s.o. meet" s.o.
    • N: pass. of G [IGI; IGI.LÁ]
    • Ntn: iter. of N 1
  • Logograms: IGI, IGI.DU8, IGI.LÁ
  • Lines: 25, 75, 136, 145
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/am%C4%81ru%20I

ana I

  • Meaning: (aš-š... etc.) "to, for" (freq. abbr. an, with assimilation of n to following consonant (OA often wr. a)) (prep., governs subst. in gen., pers. pron. in dat.) [from MB onwards DIŠ; O/MB occas. NAM; M/jB ŠÈ]
  • Logograms: DIŠ, NAM, ŠÈ
  • Lines: 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 16, 17, 18, 26, 33, 34, 35, 36, 40, 42, 43, 46, 54, 56, 60, 64, 74, 81, 94, 102, 103, 105, 117, 118, 124, 125, 126, 130, 135, 136, 141, 143, 147, 151, 164, 165, 169, 172, 180, 181, 183, 184, 185, 188
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ana%20I

annû I

"various"; NA a(n)nûte ... a(n)nûte ... "some ..., others ..."; (a)kī (h)anni(ma) "thus, in the same way";

anāhu I

  • Meaning: "to be(come) tired"
    • G: (a/a) stat. "becomes tired", "makes an effort, strives"; of buildings etc. "become dilapidated"
    • Gtn: iter. of G jB med., of limbs, person
    • D: OA "tire (s.o.), oppress"
    • Š: Bab. "trouble, exert, strain" s.o.; stat. "is very wearied"
    • Št: "make an effort", "weary o.s., be depressed"; astr. "endure"
    • N: OB "become tired", "struggle, suffer hardship, be exhausted"
  • Lines: 15
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/an%C4%81hu%20I

anāku I

  • Lines: 121
